upgrades.name: Warp Drive
upgrades.tooltip: Trove Hunters warp to distant targets. The drive takes 10 seconds to recharge.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: A late-game fleet milestone. Prestige upgrades multiply gem value and fleet output to bring this within reach.

upgrades.name: Return Gate
upgrades.tooltip: Each full Trove Hunter has a 30% chance to open a gate and deliver its cargo instantly.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: The final fleet milestone. Combine permanent value and fleet multipliers with a developed Trove Hunter fleet.

upgrades.name: Gem Value
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the bonus value of gems.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawn Quality
upgrades.tooltip: Improve the spawn chances of more valuable gems. Quality upgrades along the color branch prepare the next color; ten upgrades are available in total.

upgrades.name: Unlock Light Green Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Allows valuable light green gems to appear in normal gem spawns. Base value: 2.

upgrades.name: Unlock Blue Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Allows rare blue gems to appear in normal gem spawns. Base value: 4.

upgrades.name: Unlock Teal Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Allows rare teal gems to appear in normal gem spawns. Base value: 8.

upgrades.name: Unlock Lilac Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Allows very rare lilac gems to appear in normal gem spawns. Base value: 16.

upgrades.name: Unlock Purple Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Allows exceptionally valuable purple gems to appear in normal gem spawns. Base value: 32.

upgrades.name: Unlock Gold Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Allows extremely valuable gold gems to appear in normal gem spawns. Base value: 64.

upgrades.name: Unlock Dark Blue Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Allows the rarest and most valuable dark blue gems to appear in normal gem spawns. Base value: 128.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawn Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Decrease time between gems spawning.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawn Rate
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of gems that spawn each cooldown period.

upgrades.name: Max Gem Count
upgrades.tooltip: Increase maximum gem spawn count.

upgrades.name: Expand Space
upgrades.tooltip: Expand space and prestige to earn purple gems and reset regular upgrades.

upgrades.name: Prestige
upgrades.tooltip: Prestige to earn purple gems and reset regular upgrades while keeping the current space size and camera zoom.

upgrades.name: Passive Income
upgrades.tooltip: Increase amount of passively generated gems every second.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: This is also affected and increased by the 'Gem Value' upgrade.

upgrades.name: Ability Point
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the ability points by one.

upgrades.name: Homebase Collector
upgrades.tooltip: If enabled, the homebase will automatically collect gems within its collection range.

upgrades.name: Homebase Collection Range
upgrades.tooltip: Increase homebase collection range.

upgrades.name: Cluster Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Gives gems a chance to spawn in a cluster.

upgrades.name: Cluster Chance
upgrades.tooltip: Increase chance for gems to spawn in a cluster.

upgrades.name: Cluster Size
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of gems that will spawn in each cluster.

upgrades.name: Lucky Gems
upgrades.tooltip: Allows unusually valuable lucky gems to spawn.

upgrades.name: Lucky Gem Chance
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the chance for a spawned gem to become lucky.

upgrades.name: Lucky Gem Value
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the value multiplier of lucky gems.

upgrades.name: Cluster Core
upgrades.tooltip: Adds a gem worth five times as much to the center of every cluster.

upgrades.name: Gem Shower
upgrades.tooltip: Periodically creates a screen-wide shower of gems.

upgrades.name: Gem Shower Size
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the number of gems released by each Gem Shower.

upgrades.name: Gem Shower Frequency
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce the time between Gem Showers.

upgrades.name: Motherlode
upgrades.tooltip: Clusters have a chance to contain three times as many gems.

upgrades.name: Gem Comet
upgrades.tooltip: Periodically sends a comet across the screen that leaves a gem trail.

upgrades.name: Gem Comet Size
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the number of gems left behind by each Gem Comet.

upgrades.name: Gem Comet Frequency
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce the time between Gem Comets.

upgrades.name: Cosmic Clusters
upgrades.tooltip: Gem Comets and Gem Showers can spawn clusters at 50% of your normal cluster chance, using your cluster size, Cluster Core, Motherlode, Supercluster, and Monochrome Vein upgrades.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: A late-game goal for your spawn engine. Build up permanent gem value, collection and delivery multipliers through prestige.

upgrades.name: Supercluster
upgrades.tooltip: Clusters have a chance to spawn as three connected clusters.

upgrades.name: Monochrome Vein
upgrades.tooltip: Clusters have a chance for every gem to share one quality and color.

upgrades.name: Click Radius
upgrades.tooltip: Increase mouse click radius.

upgrades.name: Click Magnetizer
upgrades.tooltip: No tooltip
